House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to insurance; designation of payment by dental organizations; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62Q.78, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62Q.78, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 9.+]

[+Designation of payment.+]

[+Upon written request by an enrollee, a dental organization shall provide payment for dental care services directly to the rendering dentist regardless of the dentist's participation in the dental organization's provider network. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to insurance; designation of payment by dental organizations; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62Q.78, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62Q.78, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 9.

Designation of payment.

Upon written request by an enrollee, a dental organization shall provide payment for dental care services directly to the rendering dentist regardless of the dentist's participation in the dental organization's provider network.
additions: Upon written request by an enrollee, a dental organization shall provide payment for dental care services directly to the rendering dentist regardless of the dentist's participation in the dental organization's provider network.
